echoParts: A new commandment I give you
verseText: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
meaning: Jesus commands us to love each other like he loved us, and he loved us enough to give his life in our place.

recall.question: What new commandment did Jesus give?

meaning.question: What is the model for our love?

application.prompt: Show Jesus-like love to someone today by putting their good ahead of your convenience.
